title: ACEF v1.1 Transparency Disclosure Payload (overlay)
description: ACEF Core v1.1 overlay of transparency_disclosure. Inlines the v1.0 property set (kept backward-compatible) and adds conditional discriminator-keyed oneOf enforcement for the verification_badge variant (per VAL-VARIANT-004 and the v1.1 variant-registry entry for /payload/disclosure_subtype = 'verification_badge'). Records that do NOT set /payload/disclosure_subtype validate exactly as under v1.0. Records that set it to 'verification_badge' MUST satisfy the badge_id / claim / expires_at / signing_kid required-field set.

variant.description: Discriminator for payload variants from v1.0 (e.g., 'publication_evidence').

disclosure_subtype.description: v1.1 discriminator field for transparency_disclosure variants. Values defined in v1.1 variant-registry.json. Currently includes: 'verification_badge'.

intended_use.description: Intended use of the AI system as described in the disclosure.

prohibited_uses.description: Prohibited uses of the AI system.

risk_warnings.description: Risk warnings included in the disclosure.

interpretation_guidance.description: Guidance on how to interpret system outputs.

explanation_methods.description: Explanation methods available for system outputs.

confidence_indicators.description: How confidence or uncertainty is communicated in system outputs.

known_failure_modes.description: Known failure modes described in the disclosure.

out_of_scope_uses.description: Uses that are out of scope for the AI system.

summary_published.description: Whether the summary has been publicly published (publication_evidence variant).

publication_url.description: URL where the disclosure is published (publication_evidence variant).

publication_content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the published content (publication_evidence variant).

reporting_period.description: Reporting period covered by the disclosure.

badge_id.description: URN-shaped identifier for the verification badge (verification_badge variant).

claim.description: Human-readable claim displayed by the verification badge (verification_badge variant).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which this badge claim expires (verification_badge variant).

signing_kid.description: Key ID of the JWS key whose signature backs this badge (verification_badge variant).

allOf.$comment: VAL-VARIANT-004 conditional oneOf enforcement for verification_badge. When /payload/disclosure_subtype is 'verification_badge', the badge-specific required-field set applies. When unset (or any other value), no additional constraint is imposed — preserving the v1.0 envelope's openness and existing variant flow (publication_evidence keyed on /payload/variant).
